text:
Ava (PM): Quick quarterly OKR check — shipped: runtime-v3 autoscale canary. Slipped: payments-v2 (DB migration + merge). Next steps below, tagging owners.

Sanjay (Eng Lead): Thanks. For payments-v2: what's the immediate blocker? infra config or test failures?

Marta (Eng): Blocked on DB migration test failure in CI after the rebase — test `user_migration_spec` flakes. Also hitting a conflict with the payments schema change in main.

Lee (SRE): CI showed a transient connection timeout on the integration envs. I restarted the pipeline once; deploy-bot shows `integration-tests` failed then queued. I'll keep an eye on logs.

Marta (Eng): repro steps I used: 
```
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
./scripts/run-tests.sh tests/integration/user_migration_spec
```
The failure looks like a race with background workers.

Kai (Infra): Also noticed autoscaler config for canary is tight — OOM when burst > 8 pods. Suggest `max_instances: 12` and bump CPU request by 10%. I can open the PR.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline restarted for branch payments-v2/fix-migration — run id 6789 — status: queued

Sasha (Design): UI copy for the new rate-limit banner shipped with canary; docs still show old text. @Ava can you own the doc update so PM + design stay synced?

Ava (PM): I will own the docs. Marta — can you prioritize the migration fix today? If it looks like a long rebase, prepare a short-lived feature flag and a rollback PR to avoid blocking the quarter milestone.

Marta (Eng): I'll try to fix tests in the next 2 hours. If rebase takes >2h I'll open a rollback PR and flip a feature flag. Ping me if you need the rollback earlier.

Sanjay (Eng Lead): Plan summary (agreed):
- Marta: rebase + test fix (2hr sprint)
- If >2hr -> Marta opens rollback PR + feature flag
- Kai: infra tweak PR for `max_instances` now
- Ava: docs copy update for rate-limit banner
- Lee: monitor canary metrics during rollout and flag anomalies here
Please update this thread when each step completes. :thumbsup:

Kai (Infra): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/912 — changeset bumps `max_instances` and CPU requests. Adding @Lee for validation.

Lee (SRE): I'll validate once CI for infra passes. Also will add a temporary alert tweak for canary to avoid noisy paging during reversion.

Marta (Eng): CI passed on re-run after I squashed a flaky timing check. Pushed branch `payments-v2/fix-migration`. If anyone wants to smoke test locally: `./scripts/local-smoke payments-v2`

Ava (PM): Great. Marking payments-v2 as "back on track" for the OKR milestone if deploy goes green. Thanks everyone — update this thread with final deploy status and any postmortem notes.

Sanjay (Eng Lead): Nice work. Once deploy is green we'll call shipped and update the milestone board.

deploy-bot: Deploy for payments-v2/fix-migration completed — status: success — canary rollout 100% — metrics stable.

Ava (PM): Shipped ✅ I'll update the OKR tracker and docs this afternoon.

Marta (Eng): Will follow up with a short note on the flaky test and a small test hardening PR.

Lee (SRE): Monitoring looks fine for the next 60m, no regressions in latency. Closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:
